editorialSummary.heading: Homecoming, longer holiday weekends and a May graduation finish
highlights: October 9 homecoming has early dismissal; October 12 is a student holiday
Students return January 6 after Christmas and January staff days
Spring Break March 29-April 2 follows two more student days off
paragraphs: Hamilton’s fall calendar includes a longer Labor Day weekend: students stay home Tuesday, September 8 for professional learning after Monday’s holiday. October has a similar planning point. Homecoming and the first-quarter end share an early-dismissal day on October 9, followed by a student-free teacher workday Monday, October 12. Regular classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, October 13.

The days around the larger breaks also matter for pickup and travel. November 20 has early dismissal before Thanksgiving week. December 17 and 18 are shortened days before Christmas Holidays, which run December 21-31. New Year’s Day and the January 4-5 staff days keep students out until the explicitly listed January 6 return. In March, students leave early March 24, then have a teacher workday and Good Friday off before the named March 29-April 2 Spring Break.

May 20 and 21 are the final early-dismissal dates. HCHS Baccalaureate is May 20 at 7 p.m., and graduation is May 21 at 8 p.m.; graduates have separate reporting and rehearsal times. The district’s final school day is also May 21. Progress and grade-report dates appear on the second PDF page, while the school office handles final report-card distribution without a single published release date.

about.dataSource: The district’s two-page 2026-2027 calendar linked from its Events Calendar page, supplemented by the HCHS Class of 2027 page, senior calendar and graduation plan for school-specific visiting and ceremony arrangements. The local district calendar and current official download have matching SHA-256 hashes. The PDF prints HCSB approval on April 14, 2026.
about.processing: Both district PDF pages were visually reviewed alongside extracted text. Published dates, crossed-out staff days and the page-2 Non-Student Days list establish the no-class schedule. August 10 is the first day, not an early dismissal; the asterisk alone is not a schedule label. The seven explicitly listed early-dismissal dates remain attendance days. October 9, December 18, May 20 and May 21 each have one canonical occurrence with all applicable classifications. March 19 is a regular quarter-end day, not an early dismissal. March 29-April 2 is an explicitly continuous Spring Break on page 2 and across the March/April grid; keep March 25 workday and March 26 Good Friday separate. Christmas Holidays end December 31; January 1 and January 4-5 remain distinct closures and January 6 is an explicit return. The page-2 Holidays list says December 21-31, 2025, but the December 2026 grid and Non-Student Days list both specify 2026; those two consistent entries determine the event year. The May cumulative figure and four quarter counts give 174 student days, matching 205 weekdays minus 31 confirmed closures. Employee workday bullets instead use 175 student days. No missing attendance date is invented to reconcile that inconsistency. The annual statistic uses the printed 174 with an explicit source-conflict note. No daily attendance date remains ambiguous from this numerical mismatch. No final report-card event is assigned a guessed date. July/August preplanning, the August 4 staff welcome/health fair, May postplanning, the summer four-day employee week and Memorial Day after the last student day are omitted. The HCHS senior calendar is a source for HCHS visiting hours only, not an elementary bell schedule or districtwide additional attendance. Older elementary home-page hours appear under a 2025-2026 banner and were not adopted as current. PDF creation/modification metadata is not a printed revision date.
about.updates: Sources checked October 19, 2026. No later confirmed operating-calendar change was verified in the accessible district and school news. No weather closure, weather make-up reserve or unverified bell time has been added.

faqs.question: When does Hamilton County school start and end?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Monday, August 10, 2026. The last is Friday, May 21, 2027, with early dismissal. HCHS graduation is also May 21.

faqs.question: When is Meet the Teacher?
faqs.answer: Meet the Teacher is Thursday, August 6, 2026. HCHS lists 4-7 p.m., with senior schedule pickup in the cafeteria. Confirm visiting hours for Hamilton County Elementary directly with the school.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Holidays run November 23-27, 2026. Students have early dismissal Friday, November 20 and are scheduled to return Monday, November 30. With the weekends, the time off runs November 21-29.

faqs.question: When is Christmas break, and what is the January return date?
faqs.answer: Christmas Holidays are December 21-31, 2026. January 1 is a separate holiday, and January 4-5 are student-free staff days. Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. Including weekends, the planned time off is December 19-January 5, an 18-day stretch.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Hamilton County?
faqs.answer: The named Spring Break runs March 29-April 2, 2027. Students also have March 25 off for a teacher workday and March 26 off for Good Friday. With the weekends, they are out of regular classes March 25-April 4 and are scheduled to return Monday, April 5. March 24 has early dismissal.

faqs.question: Which dates have early dismissal?
faqs.answer: The seven dates are October 9, November 20, December 17 and December 18, 2026, then March 24, May 20 and May 21, 2027. These are student attendance days with a shorter schedule. August 10 is the first student day and is not listed for early dismissal.

faqs.question: What time do students leave on early-dismissal days?
faqs.answer: The annual district calendar does not give dismissal clock times. Check your child’s school for pickup, bus and after-school arrangements, particularly on homecoming and the days before holiday breaks.

faqs.question: When is homecoming, and is the following Monday a student holiday?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar schedules homecoming and early dismissal for Friday, October 9, 2026, which also ends the first quarter. Monday, October 12 is a teacher workday with no student classes. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: Do students have a four-day Labor Day weekend?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students are off Monday, September 7, 2026 for Labor Day and Tuesday, September 8 for professional learning. Including the weekend, the break runs September 5-8, with a scheduled Wednesday, September 9 return.

faqs.question: Are schools off for Veterans Day and Martin Luther King Jr. Day?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes Wednesday, November 11, 2026 for Veterans Day and Monday, January 18, 2027 for Martin Luther King Jr. Day.

faqs.question: Does Presidents Day include Tuesday off?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, February 15, 2027 is the Presidents Day holiday, and Tuesday, February 16 is a professional-learning day without regular student classes. The four-day weekend runs February 13-16; classes are scheduled to resume Wednesday, February 17.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays and professional-learning days have no student classes?
faqs.answer: The in-year student days off for staff work or professional learning are September 8 and October 12, 2026, then January 4, January 5, February 16 and March 25, 2027. Staff preplanning before August 10 and postplanning after May 21 are outside the regular student year.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday a full day off?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, March 26, 2027 is a full student holiday. Thursday, March 25 is also student-free for a teacher workday, and Spring Break follows March 29-April 2.

faqs.question: When do the quarters and semesters end?
faqs.answer: The quarters end October 9 and December 18, 2026, then March 19 and May 21, 2027. December 18 also ends the first semester, and May 21 ends the second. October 9, December 18 and May 21 have early dismissal; March 19 does not.

faqs.question: When are progress reports distributed?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are scheduled for September 10 and November 12, 2026, and February 11 and April 22, 2027.

faqs.question: When are report cards sent out?
faqs.answer: Grade reports are scheduled for October 15, 2026, January 7 and April 8, 2027. The school office handles year-end report-card distribution; the PDF does not give a final release date. Contact the school office for that arrangement.

faqs.question: When and where are HCHS graduation and Baccalaureate?
faqs.answer: HCHS graduation is Friday, May 21, 2027 at 8 p.m. at the school’s stadium. Baccalaureate is Thursday, May 20 at 7 p.m. in the auditorium. Graduates report at 6:15 p.m. for both events, to the gym for graduation and the media center for Baccalaureate. Follow the school’s graduation plan for the full instructions.

faqs.question: Is graduation practice required, and what happens if weather changes the ceremony?
faqs.answer: The HCHS plan requires graduates to attend stadium practice at 8 a.m. May 21. If Friday’s ceremony cannot safely take place outdoors, the backup is Saturday, May 22 at 10 a.m.; the gym is the next alternative if the stadium remains unsafe. The superintendent decides whether to activate the plan, and families will be notified. The backup is not an additional regular school day.

faqs.question: How many student days are listed for the year?
faqs.answer: The calendar’s May 21 entry lists 174 student days, matching its quarter counts and the published dates: 205 weekdays minus 31 no-school weekdays. Employee-workday notes on the second page instead mention 175 student days. The dated calendar supports 174; ask the district about the inconsistent employee note rather than assuming an extra class day.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official calendar and check schedule changes?
faqs.answer: The district’s Events Calendar page links the 2026-2027 District Calendar PDF, approved April 14, 2026. Check district announcements and ParentSquare for later weather or operating changes. The annual PDF does not designate reserved weather make-up dates.

sourceDiscrepancies.effect: Page 1 prints 174 cumulative student days at May 21, and its four quarter counts total 174. The explicit schedule independently yields 174 (205 weekdays minus 31 no-school weekdays). Page 2 employee-workday bullets instead refer to 175 student days. Use the date-supported, printed 174 with the conflict disclosed; do not add an unlisted date or claim the 175 figure is reconciled.

The page-2 Holidays list says December 21-31, 2025. The December 2026 month grid and page-2 Non-Student Days list both say December 21-31, 2026. The event uses the corroborated 2026 dates; the source typo is preserved here.
